message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/11036/figure_4a.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for mediastinal mass and effusion to support differential diagnosis of the anterior opacity seen on PA view."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/11036/figure_4b.jpg", "reason": "To generate a morphological description of the lateral view, specifically to confirm anterior vs posterior location and assess margin characteristics (lobulated vs smooth) which are critical for distinguishing thymic carcinoma from benign entities."}], "reason": "The question requires characterizing a mediastinal mass (location, margins, associated findings) to select the correct diagnosis. The PA view (4a) shows a widened mediastinum/anterior opacity, while the lateral view (4b) is essential for confirming anterior localization and assessing contour. I will use the classifier on the PA view to check for mass/effusion signals and the report generator on the lateral view to extract specific morphological descriptors (margins, location) needed to differentiate between the options provided (e.g., thymoma vs carcinoma vs lymphoma). No longitudinal comparison is requested, so only current images are used."}
